description: This PHP file defines the 'Monitor' class which is part of the SuiteCRM tracking module. The class implements the Trackable interface and manages tracking metrics, stores, and session data for monitoring user activity within the CRM system. It includes methods for setting and getting metric values, saving data to stores, and handling session identifiers.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: Represents a monitoring entity within SuiteCRM, handling metrics, storage, and session management for tracking user interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Monitor instance by loading metadata, setting metrics, and preparing properties based on provided parameters.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified metric for the monitor, marking it as dirty if mutable.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a specified metric.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Returns the list of store names associated with the monitor.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Returns the array of Metric objects defined for this monitor.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Indicates whether the monitor has unsaved data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the monitor's data to its stores if enabled and dirty, then clears the data.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all mutable metrics to empty values and marks the monitor as not dirty.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves or instantiates a store object by name, used for persisting monitoring data.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Generates and returns the current session ID, hashing it if it exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Exports the monitor's metrics and current values as an associative array.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the monitor from saving data.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the monitor is enabled.
